name: Mooresville (United States)
description: Yellow field charged with a ring of blue stars around a narrow blue cross, the date 1824 split across the upper quadrants, an extra star in the lower hoist quadrant and the name MOORESVILLE along the lower part of the ring.
history: Mooresville is a town in Morgan County, Indiana, home of Paul Hadley, designer of the Indiana state flag. Flags of the World records the town banner from a Mooresville Public Library flashcard.

features.role: ring of stars with a larger star at the top and an extra star in the lower hoist quadrant
